transcript: Speaker A: यह प्रिस्क्रिप्शन है, डॉक्टर ने लिखा है, दवाई दे दो। [This is the prescription, the doctor wrote it, give me the medicine.] Speaker B: सर, यह मुझे पढ़ना नहीं आ रहा। [Sir, I am not able to read this.] Speaker A: तुम्हें पढ़ना नहीं आता? तो मेडिकल शॉप में बैठी क्यों हो? कोई पढ़ा लिखा इंसान रखो यहाँ। [You don't know how to read? Then why are you sitting in a medical shop? Keep some educated person here.] Speaker C: माफ़ी चाहता हूँ सर, यह नहीं थी, मैं दे देता हूँ। मीना, तू पीछे जा। काउंटर पे मत बैठ जब तक प्रिस्क्रिप्शन पढ़ना नहीं आता। [I apologize sir, she was new, I will give it. Meena, you go to the back. Don't sit at the counter until you know how to read prescriptions.] Speaker B: सर, एक मिनट देना मुझे। [Sir, give me a minute.] Speaker C: बोल। [Speak.] Speaker B: Sir, this prescription says Tab Amoxicillin 500 mg, one tablet three times a day for five days. Syr Cetirizine 5 ml at bedtime for three days, and Cap Omeprazole 20 mg, one capsule before breakfast for seven days. Tab means tablet, Syr means syrup, Cap means capsules. Patient ko teen dawai deni hai: antibiotic, allergy ki, aur pet ki. [Sir, this prescription says... Patient needs three medicines: antibiotic, allergy, and stomach.] Speaker C: मीना... [Meena...] Speaker B: Sir, yeh dekho. Expiry check karti hoon. Amoxicillin expiry 03/2027 valid. Cetirizine expiry 11/26 valid. Omeprazole expiry 08/26 valid. Teeno de sakti hoon. [Sir, look at this. I'll check the expiry... I can give all three.] Speaker C: तूने यह कब सीखा? [When did you learn this?] Speaker B: Sir, aapne teen mahine pehle bola tha, galti se rakha hai tujhe. Us raat soyi nahi, par rona nahi chuna, seekhna chuna. [Sir, you said three months ago that I was hired by mistake. I didn't sleep that night, but I chose not to cry, I chose to learn.] Speaker C: कैसे सीखी इतनी जल्दी? [How did you learn so quickly?] Speaker B: Sir, English Seekho app download ki. General English show se start kiya. 'Hello se baat shuru karein' pehla video. 1,65,000 log dekh chuke the. Hindi mein samjhaya tha. Basic English seekhi: reading, speaking, understanding. [Sir, I downloaded the English Seekho app. Started with the General English show. 'Start conversation with Hello' was the first video. 1,65,000 people had watched it. It was explained in Hindi. Learnt basic English: reading, speaking, understanding.] Speaker C: पर प्रिस्क्रिप्शन पढ़ना तो अलग है ना? मेडिकल टर्म्स हैं उसमें? [But reading prescriptions is different, right? There are medical terms in it.] Speaker B: Sir, AI coach hai, 24 ghante available hai. Maine bola medical shop mein kaam karti hoon, prescription padhna hai. AI coach ne ek-ek term sikha diya. Tab matlab tablet, Syr matlab syrup, Cap matlab capsule, OD matlab once a day, BD matlab twice a day, TDS matlab three times a day, HS matlab at bedtime, AC matlab before food, PC matlab after food. [Sir, there is an AI coach, available 24 hours. I said I work in a medical shop and need to read prescriptions. The AI coach taught me every term...] Speaker C: Aur dawai ke naam? [And medicine names?] Speaker B: Sir, woh bhi practice ki. Paracetamol bukhar ki, Amoxicillin antibiotic, Cetirizine allergy ki, Omeprazole acidity ki. Roz 10 prescription padh ke practice karti thi. AI coach se check karwati thi. 500 baar galat padha, 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi nahi boli medical background nahi hai, tujhse nahi hoga. [Sir, practiced those too... Practiced reading 10 prescriptions daily. Checked with AI coach. Read wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said you don't have a medical background, you can't do it.] Speaker C: मीना, आज से तू काउंटर पे बैठेगी, कस्टमर हैंडल करेगी। [Meena, from today you will sit at the counter and handle customers.] Speaker B: Sir, thank you. Aur sir, ek request hai. Aapki doosri branch mein bhi do ladkiyan hain, unhe bhi English nahi aati. Agar woh bhi English Seekho app download karein, General English show se start karein, AI coach se medical terms practice karein, toh ek mahine mein prescription padh lengi. Galat dawai dene ka risk nahi rahega, aapki dukan safe rahegi, aur koi unhe galti se rakha nahi bolega. [Sir, thank you. And sir, one request... if they also download English Seekho app... they will learn to read prescriptions in a month. No risk of giving wrong medicine, your shop will be safe, and no one will say they were hired by mistake.] Speaker D: Install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. summary: A pharmacy assistant is scolded for not being able to read an English prescription. She uses the English Seekho app and its 24/7 AI coach to learn basic English and medical abbreviations. Her boss is impressed by her progress, promotes her to the counter, and she recommends the app for other staff.
